items.name: Online & server name
items.description: Active if server name matches configured filter
items.param: Monitor name (use “*” to match any character, leave string empty to see the name when starting a race)

items.name: Two or more desktops
items.description: Second monitor is connected and extends desktop

items.name: Primary monitor name
items.description: Leave monitor name empty to see a message with the current monitor name
items.param: Monitor name (use “*” to match any character, leave string empty to see the name when starting a race)
items.script: param == '' and sysutils.message('Primary monitor name:\n'..sysutils.primarymonitor()) or strutils.match(param, sysutils.primarymonitor())

items.name: Discharging battery
items.description: Active if PC/laptop is not currently connected to power
